PLAN "Vegan Hypertrophy 12-Week"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Muscle gain (hypertrophy)"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1 - Foundation" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Upper Push/Pull":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 4x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          incline_press 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 4x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          bicep_curl 3x10..12 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 60m "Lower Hypertrophy":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x8..10 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 4x8..10 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          leg_press 3x10..12 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          leg_curl 3x10..12 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          calf_raise 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x60..60 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 60m "Full Body Volume":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift 3x5..6 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          dumbbell_press 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          bent_over_row 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds

          tricep_pushdown 3x10..12 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
